property.name: apiUrl
property.label: API Base URL
property.description: Base URL of the Railway-hosted backend (e.g. https://your-app.up.railway.app). Add this origin to Salesforce CSP Trusted Sites before deploying.

property.name: apiPrefix
property.label: API Path Prefix
property.description: Path prefix for the shopping API endpoints (default: /api).

property.name: assistantName
property.label: Assistant Name
property.description: Display name shown in the chat header and activity indicator.

property.name: brandName
property.label: Brand Name
property.description: Store name shown on the toggle button and panel header.

property.name: placeholder
property.label: Input Placeholder
property.default: Ask about a product, an order, or anything in the store…
property.description: Placeholder text inside the message composer.

property.name: introText
property.label: Intro Text
property.default: Your AI shopping assistant. Ask about products, orders, returns, or recommendations.
property.description: Short intro shown above the starter prompts before the first message.
